take: Buffalo announced it recalled defenseman Dennis Gilbert from Rochester (AHL) and placed Matt Grzelcyk on injured reserve. Gilbert has played three games this season, with a goal and an assist, and has averaged 10:16 a night. Grzelcyk was a third-pair player at 14:27 a night, and in the five games since he went out, Owen Power has moved up to 27:08 a night and Mattias Samuelsson to 25:26, so those two should keep absorbing his minutes.
